visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair and fair skin is seen in a medium close-up, resting her right chin on her hand, looking thoughtfully towards the upper left. She wears a white ribbed long-sleeved top, a ring on her finger, and a black patterned bracelet. The background is a clean, minimalist white wall with a hint of a textured lamp to the right. (2) A split-screen comparison appears; the top frame labeled 'Before' shows her bare skin with slight redness, while the bottom 'After' frame shows smoother, more even skin tone. She points to her cheek to emphasize the difference. (3) Back to the medium shot, she talks expressively, holding up two containers of mineral powder. She now wears a black headband with pink and black character ears (Melody/Kuromi style). (4) The camera focuses on the products on a white surface: a large black circular container and a smaller clear square container, both branded with 'Rachel Wine' in white script surrounded by purple floral patterns. (5) In an editing montage, she applies the powder to her face using a dense kabuki-style brush, looking into the lens. A smartphone on a tripod displaying a timer is visible in the background. (6) High-definition close-up shots of her face show the makeup's luminous, glowing finish under bright indoor lighting. (7) She holds her smartphone close to the camera lens, showing a stopwatch timer at exactly 3 minutes, proving the speed of application. (8) A series of close-up 'After 8hrs' shots show her skin still looking fresh and radiant with minimal wear. (9) Large text overlays appear on a white background listing specific store locations in Taipei, Taichung, and Kaohsiung. (10) She leans in close to the lens, whispering with her hand partially covering her mouth as if sharing a secret, concluding the video.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A friendly female voice begins a narrative with a casual yet professional tone, explaining the struggles of having sensitive skin. The background music is an upbeat, mid-tempo acoustic track featuring bright guitar strumming and a light drum beat. (2) A subtle digital 'ding' SFX occurs during a transition to the split-screen visual. The music continues consistently without interruption. (3) The speaker's volume remains steady as she introduces 'Rachel Wine' mineral powder. The acoustic texture is clean and studio-processed with a high signal-to-noise ratio. (4) As the montage of application begins, short 'whoosh' sounds are heard synchronized with the fast visual cuts. The guitar-driven BGM provides a rhythmic backbone. (5) Toward the end, the speaker's tone shifts to a quiet, conspiratorial whisper for the giveaway announcement. The BGM maintains its volume until a clean fade-out at the final frame.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Problem -> Solution -> Demonstration -> Proof -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional endorsement for Rachel Wine mineral foundation, specifically targeting viewers with sensitive or rosacea-prone skin. It combines personal storytelling about skin struggles with a fast, effective demonstration and long-wear evidence to build trust and drive sales through listed store locations and a giveaway.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator explicitly names the brand Rachel Wine, shows the product packaging, demonstrates its use, lists physical store locations, and mentions a giveaway.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively uses high-quality close-up photography to validate the 'glowing' skin claim. The 3-minute timer provides a concrete 'ease of use' metric, which is a strong selling point for short-form video consumers.
